title: An MCP server for store associates (read-only by default)
area: AI integration: tools, MCP and security
scenario: Kestrel wants one MCP server for store tools shared by several internal agents. The first draft mirrors the REST API: full records with supplier cost, customer emails and phones, any store's orders and a write tool open to everyone. Rebuild it as a task-shaped, least-privilege server.
task: Task-shaped tools with model-facing descriptions and schema-validated inputs
Compact results with a more-results hint; actionable isError messages
Store-scoped, minimized order lookup; read-only unless a write scope is granted
Two-step hold with an expiring single-use token; hours resource; audit trail
acceptance: No supplier cost, email, phone or other stores' orders in any output
Hold only via prepare then confirm, once, before expiry
